fields.headline: GREENSOMES.
fields.body: The format to reach for when the handicaps are a long way apart.

fields.headline:
BOTH DRIVE,
ONE BALL.
fields.body: Both partners tee off, the side keeps the better drive, then plays alternate shots with that ball until it is holed.

fields.headline: 60 AND 40.
fields.body: The side plays off 60% of the lower course handicap plus 40% of the higher. Not half and half, because the better driver gets used more.

fields.headline:
CHANGE IT,
KEEP THE DRAW.
fields.body: Move the 60 or the 40 and the handicaps re-derive on the pairings you already drew. Change the format itself and the draw clears. Both lock once a hole is in.

fields.headline:
YOUR CUP.
LIVE.
fields.body: Free to build, pay to publish, free to play.
